steps.name: an uninvited visit
steps.objective: Check what happened to [Mediah] and complete the quest for [Mediah].

lines.text: (Inside Kali Village, through the thick darkness that only Medea can see, someone's figure continues to speak to him.)
I didn't want you to move.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I don't know for what purpose you kept me by your side. However, at some point, I realized that I had a name other than Medea... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I came to resent you. A blurry memory pulled out from the abyss you trapped... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I believed there was something behind that and your disappearance, but not anymore.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The fact that he irresponsibly disappeared as the leader of the Kali tribe is reason enough. They all saw me coming here as a child with my family.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: He even pretends to be me when I'm not there... . Why did you come to us when you abandoned us? It's not the night I've been waiting for so why!
It's to do what you want.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It won't work out the way you want it to.
Child, you call me ‘you’… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea? Who are you talking to now? . Why is it dark here?
(The figure in the dark is slightly startled by the voice of %s calling Mediah.)
That's fascinating. You can see this darkness and hear my voice... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you… ?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (%s's hand holding the weapon slowly gains strength.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, step back.
My child, I have not come today for any purpose, so I will leave.
Adventurer, I don't know how we will meet later... .
Let me show you what he looks like.
(The thick darkness surrounding the woman grows larger and soon swallows everyone.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what? This, this… ?
(As part of the thick darkness disperses, an unfamiliar place comes into view. Dense sand fog and structures buried between huge sand dunes are visible.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Where am I? And that person….)
(A man stands alone in a never-ending sandstorm.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That's Vice... Does that mean this is Avalon?)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Now the preparations are complete. Am I the only one left... .
(Vice is slowly looking around as if nothing is wrong with the appearance of %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Can’t you see me?)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Now all that's left is the key... .
(Weiss realizes something is strange and looks around.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...you didn't notice me, did you?)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Was it because of my mood?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: A lot has happened in the meantime. I felt this way when I came here... .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: The day you want will not come. Because I want this moment and will never back down... .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Of course, it wasn't my fault.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: The witch played a prank.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: I'm ready to open the door and I'll be waiting. The Adventurer of the goddess… . Come to Avalon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Did you see me…!! Huh?)
(The moment the two people’s eyes meet, vague, unknown memories flow into %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Explosions keep happening….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A suspicious door opens, and beings from another world appear inside. Hoping for the destruction of that place...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A person crying while holding on to dying people….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Worlds other than this one are disappearing...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Uh, over there….)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: I'll tell you. That place is Azrael... . Now the world loved by the goddess will become like Azrael.

lines.speaker: 메디아의 목소리
lines.text: (Get a grip, %s!!)

steps.name: Iris and Media
steps.objective: Talk to [Iris] in the “Oracle Room” and visit the sealed location in “Deborah Snowfield.” Then, meet with “Frozen” and go inside the “Flaming Wheel” to report the quest to [Shinyk].

lines.text: (Along with Mediah's voice, the sight of Avalon disperses and disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, why did I… . No, Medea? Obviously… When I came... . That person... . No, more than that, why was I crying?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You saw something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And it seems like there is someone who came to see Medea... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you doing now?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's not what you think.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You came here to dissuade me from going to Avalon. However, he died after realizing that it wasn't working.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So I will never interfere in the final battle with Vice. Because I also have my own ‘role’.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As for the role of a witch... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Let's go first. There is no time. Iris is calling.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it Iris? ah… .
(A wind like Iris's warm hand blows from somewhere and enters %s's arms.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Come with me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .
(As we arrive at the place where the warm wind has guided everyone, beautiful flower petals flutter.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Iris This is where you are.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it is a space where you can meet Iris.
(With %s's words, Iris greets the two with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Welcome, Mediah, %s.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Iris, nice to meet you. Now that I think about it… .
(Medea smiles lightly and looks at Iris.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This is what it felt like, %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I can't believe I tried to have this person all to myself... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I didn't do that on purpose... . No, that's not it... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There is no need to panic. Just kidding.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you kidding?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Medea too... . Uh, Medea?!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hehe, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you. It must have been very difficult for you all, but you made a decision for everyone... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: No. Since that power is not entirely mine, I gave back at least some of that power.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Are you okay? Medea’s choice is… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Once again, I'm fine. The remaining half of the power... . I don't know how to get rid of this yet... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We will continue to try. In order not to lose everyone... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: (And in order not to lose me… Iris, even if I look different, I….)
(As Iris quietly nods, Medea also laughs lightly.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Now that I’ve said my greetings, I’ll send you two to the Deborah Snowfield.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Now I feel like I'm going to Avalon...)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s… , I'm sorry for leaving the hard work to %s. What I saw in Avalon... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I am for Iris, for everyone… , because I like it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There will be a lot of things that Iris will know only if I find out a lot. and… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's a story I want to hear from Vice. So Iris, don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Oh, I feel a crack in the great wall. I will continue to block this rift as much as I can.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We'll go right away, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes, Medea. Now, please close your eyes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I’ll be back, Iris… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Deborah It’s a snowy field… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Although it is a snowy field, it feels cooler than cold.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's probably because it's a land that Io has protected for a long time. Otherwise, it might have been a mess like other places.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess so?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There's someone over there... . It seems like they were waiting for us. Demigod… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Demigod?
(A man sees Medea and %s arriving inside the Deborah Snowfield and waves.)
Mediah and %s… , right?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you… ? Are you Frozen?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: That's right. I am Frozen. If you are %s… , I heard a lot of stories. Nice to meet you.
(Frozen holds out his hand to shake.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, nice to meet you too.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: I would like to speak comfortably to %s, is that okay?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: I'll just treat Medea like I deal with other superhumans.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, you can. I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Okay. First, since we don't have much time, let's go inside.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Deborah connected the snow field with a certain place. There are other people waiting inside as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you don't have time, you should go quickly.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Shall we go, Medea?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The others have already arrived. All right. Maybe this place... .

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: That's right. The place prepared by Shinik… . Please follow me.
(Frozen walks in front, and the two follow behind. After a while, the pure white snow field gradually turns into an unknown, chaotic darkness.)
(As a very short period of time passes, the darkness that enveloped everyone gradually disappears. And a landscape that has never been seen before appears before them.)
(The night sky and the space where the stars shine are endless, and there is something like a bar erected to prevent anyone from going outside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This doesn't seem like our world. But it's not another world... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It seems like a place on the border. great wall... .

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Now, two people. Go over there. Shinik is waiting for you. I will patrol Avalon one more time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn't it dangerous if you go alone?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: It's okay because Ren is going with me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, wait a minute, I've heard this name before... .

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Ren is Jiscard's third disciple. He is also my attendant now. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Well then, everyone, see you later.
(As if she had noticed that Frozen was retreating, a girl holding a huge Death Scythe came forward from inside.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Found a fun-looking face♡

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shinik, this is your… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea, hush it until I say so. Hehehe, make a stupid face and come here %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shinik. I think it’s okay here too… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The floor there is so weak that it will break and fall right away.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If you want to stay in a place where you don't know where you'll end up, you're not dead even if you die, and you're not alive even if you live, so you can stay there ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahhh, help me!

steps.name: A wheel that doesn't turn (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Shainic] and [Baldric] in “The Burning Wheel.” Then complete the quest to [Io].

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: As expected, Shineek, you are mischievous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? If Shinik is being mischievous... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Just kidding♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, you were surprised.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, it's too early to be surprised. Look at Baldrick crawling up from the floor over there.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: … Phew, I thought I was going to die because the floor fell out.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: When designing this place, I thought I wouldn't die, so I kept it reasonable, but it seems like that happens sometimes.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Don’t worry, there is no place like that anymore. If you doubt the day I created Tartarus by myself, you can’t do it♡

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shinik, is this place a long time ago? That time when Adrika was shaken... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: This is a kind of prison. I was wondering what kind of pain I would inflict on the old man who cursed me, and I was looking for a place to imprison him.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I went crazy and was digging through a construction site and even broke through the great wall.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I was thinking of burying that inspiration here, but I didn't ♡, good job, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well done.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Thanks to you, it was better because you did ▒▒ and ▒▒.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey Shinik… , that… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hehe, if you lock them here, they will suffer like a cogwheel for eternity... . That wasn't fun.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If that old man's face was here, it would have been difficult to get out of this place later... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Anyway, here's what I brought up again. There are people who will put it back and bury it. Both things are good. It would be nice to keep the fire burning, but it's all gone.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shinik, I can't believe they brought it out again... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea, don't worry too much about that. Because I buried it, I was able to live a sane life until now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shinik, what is that… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Rain~mil♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It can't be helped because it's non-wheat.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Don't worry, I won't use it on you♡

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shinik, if you really use that, %s… I die.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's right. Are you really dying?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Please save me.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Don't worry, I won't do that. And since inspiration is helping, that won’t happen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Adkina?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The old dragon is keeping this place from collapsing. Avalon and this place, even Deborah Snowfield. It's really amazing.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So, you have to fight with all your might. I will look at the situation here and Avalon and find Vice.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So take care, %s. It's for everyone, for life, and for the Goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shinik… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea's place is next to the meat fool, Io, and Uncle Ziscard. Just stand there.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'll go to my seat after seeing Adkina.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yeah. Because it's okay now.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Then %s, Media and say hello to everyone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey Shinik, is there such a thing as a ‘seat’?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's complicated to explain, so I'll just say it's something superhumans have. Of course there is no room for you♡ If you want to become a superman, no one will die... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. I understand!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, then I'll go see Adkina! Let’s go, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Brothers, are you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Baldrick. It’s been a while since I last saw you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Brothers… ?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Medea is a younger sister than me. %s is also mine. So guys, let’s do it.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, you say so. If the King of Evil so wishes... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: The evil king is called by his name or uncle.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, he's really an old man, but you can't call him that carelessly... . Phew, yes, of course. Baldrick.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Okay, brothers. Let's do our best.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, thank you.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Thanks to Mediah's decision, that bad guy was able to hold off calling on an even worse guy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A bad guy and an even worse guy... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Understanding is a mysterious way of speaking...)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: No. I just did what I had to do.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There is still a lot of work to be done. Let’s get ready here and then go.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Okay, okay. Let's all run wild together for the first time in a while!

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Okay, I will properly beat up Vice!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I look forward to it.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: The two of you, when you have time, spar with me for a moment... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Oh, I forgot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baldrick, I'll bring you some good meat from another continent later. Then, Medea and I will go to Adkina.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: What? Meat from another continent!! Brother, you’re really cool!! I look forward to it!
(Medea looks at %s's face as if surprised to see Baldrick obediently letting her go.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Great job, %s… .  I was impressed... , no. Please go.

steps.name: A wheel that doesn't turn (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Io] and [Jiscard] in “The Burning Wheel.” Then complete the quest to [Dragon Adkina].

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s and Miss Medea, welcome. I waited.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, how are you?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Are you saying I saw you a while ago and had a good time? Hehehe.
(Io hugs Medea after %s.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Miss Medea, thank you for coming.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Io, you don’t have to be that grateful. What to do... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's the same for us too. So don't worry about anything else right now. Okay?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes… .
(Io appears with a bright smile as if she is satisfied with Medea’s answer.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Oh, that's right. %s… . Did you hear the explanation of [The Burning Wheel]?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I heard a little bit.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Yeah? Still, I think it would be better to tell you one more time... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: This is the border between our world and other people's worlds. You can think of it as a middle ground.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Iris Even if you are a star god, you cannot know all the worlds. Now you know our world, Eastland... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: This is an area beyond Iris's influence. So, you, who are mentally connected, need to know a lot of information.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: And the same goes for Avalon. It's a place in Eastland, but Iris has no idea about it because it's been eroded by the power of the other world brought by Vice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know what you mean.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I think he looks like he doesn't know... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Io explained it well, so there's no way you wouldn't know.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Oh my, %s… . I know how to say things like that. It's not normal either.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Io, then let’s go see Adkina.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Hey, Miss Medea? Shineek unnie is Shineek, but why am I called Io?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, then what would you like to be called?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Speak comfortably, if possible, Io-san?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: In the village, there are only younger siblings who are hundreds of years younger than me, so I wish I had a younger sibling who isn't that much older than me.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Well, the age difference between me and Io is not that small, but... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Um, Miss Medea? I'm kidding. joke. Don't be too nervous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Both of them were embarrassed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now I'm going to go say hello to Jiscard and Adkina.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Io, I will go too.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Yeah, okay. There's plenty of time to talk, so let's do it later.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Maybe it's because I didn't expect %s and Mediah to come together, but I'm even more happy to see them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Jiscard.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Long time no see. I'm sorry about Youngji's situation.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Nope. It must have been complicated for you back then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, have you ever been to the territory, Medea?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Okay, wait… .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I had some business to run so I came and went for a bit. %s, did you hear the story about the Burning Wheel?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I heard you. Can you tell us about the state of Avalon right now?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Yes, Avalon… .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: There is no one in Avalon right now. To be precise, there are no people in our world who have vitality.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What is that... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It seems that all living things in Avalon have already been reduced to the power of binding. That's why I said there was nothing.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It seems that Weiss used her power to create all the life she used, everything except herself.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Even the subordinates, demons, and demons who had been brainwashed by him and followed him disappeared and became his strength... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Regardless of Weiss, the beings that roam Avalon are nothing but the remnants of the world, wishing for its destruction.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It would be convenient to think of them as monsters from another world. %s… .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Medea is right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is Weiss trying to do?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: He made Avalon into a different space like the world he knew. That might be… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Connect… You're trying to do it.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: That's right. I don't know what will happen, but Deimos will be at the center.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We have to stop it quickly.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: That's why we are here. Including you... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Frozen and Ren are patrolling now. He said he would let me know if he found out anything, so in the meantime, go see Adkina and say hello.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. But what’s over there… . A huge dragon? It's that big, why couldn't I see it?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Can you finally see that dragon now? This is Adkina.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Are you Adkina?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, I've gotten used to this space, so I can finally see Adkina.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow… .
(It seems like Adkina is saying something to %s.)
(However, Adkina's voice is filled with an unknown power and pierces my ears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, my ears hurt… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Jiscard, let’s hurry and go to Adkina.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Okay. He needs to calm down quickly, so send him there quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, yes… . See you later. Jiscard.

steps.name: Avalon shaking
steps.objective: Defeat [Accidentally Gamaliel] and [Apple Tariel] in 「Avalon」. Then complete the quest to [Ren] in “Avalon.”

lines.text: (A huge dragon with eyes shining like jewels is sitting inside a burning wheel, looking at the road leading somewhere.)
(Then he turns his gaze when he sees two people coming towards him.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Adkina, it’s been a while since I saw you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Adkina?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaah, Adkina. My ears, my ears feel like they're going to tear. It hurts.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Ah… ?
(Adkina nods as if he finally understood. After a while, when he opens his mouth, any power directed at %s disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, now… . It's okay now.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'm sorry. It's been a while since I've talked to someone like this, so I forgot to control it.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Shinik, Jiscard, Baldric, and Io were fine, so I thought you would be fine too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But what did you say?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: He said he was waiting and that it was nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … That's what it said.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: What you are hearing now is the language of the ancient Pluton Dragon, Dragon Language... Let's say it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: With a little bit of control I made sure you could hear my language.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: In ancient times, the Pluton Dragon used all his might to disguise himself so that other unholy ones would not hear our story.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I guess you can think of it as a kind of converted signal.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: So only Ceres and those who Ceres has given permission can hear. You too can hear it because you are with Iris.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Otherwise, I might have lost my mind after continuing to listen to it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I'm glad I'm alive.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Haha, you too… . Medea, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I didn't ask about verbs... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If that's the case, you don't have to worry.
(Mediah smiles slightly.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Okay, thank you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then I will go to my seat. Then, %s, please talk to Adkina.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Ah, yes. I will.
(As Medea bows and walks away, Adkina quietly raises her head and looks into space.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Adkina, why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The door to Avalon has opened. The door created by Weiss has opened and the power of another world is flowing in.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: You may not feel it now, but I can feel it when I'm close to the great wall.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should I do?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Find Frozen and Ren through the gate to Avalon. I won't be able to come back in here because of this.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Deborah I am guarding this place to prevent the power of restraint from flowing into the snowfields, so don’t worry too much about this place.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Except for me, the rest of the group will go look for Vice as soon as we're done here. So don't be too pushy and find Frozen and join him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The goddess is working hard to keep the wall from collapsing, so everyone must overcome it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Adkina, I'll be back then.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Come back.
(I can't see Dragon Adkina's expression clearly, but I can feel Adkina's unique generous smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Can I go through that door? I can feel an ominous force outside...)
(As soon as %s disappears from the burning wheel, Shinik comes running at high speed from afar.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Inspiration!! What's going on out there, right?!
(Then he falls because he is caught by a wheel on the floor.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I always told you to be careful because you might fall if you run like that... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'm not a kid! are you okay! no… . Am I really okay?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Shinik… .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Don't worry. It's not your fault. It wasn't your fault to begin with.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Thanks, inspiration.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I did everything I could to be forgiven, but I couldn't be forgiven because everyone died. Phew, that can't be helped... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So I'm going to do something that doesn't require anyone's forgiveness. Are you okay?♡
(After arriving at the dark place, you can feel the familiar air of Eastland, different from the burning wheel.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's the same as what I saw before I came here.
(Through the thick sandy fog, you can see buildings and houses that look like they were built in a huge city.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there really nothing right now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing… . Ugh, ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Everything is frustrating. It's not so much that I can't move, but it's... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it bondage?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Adkina told us to find Frozen and a man named Ren, so let's go quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But where do we go? It's too wide. I need to know where those two are... .
(At that time, the sound of a woman cheering is heard from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Whose voice is it?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure where it is, but I need to go there quickly. It might be dangerous... .

steps.name: Shining Star Sword
steps.objective: Defeat [Green Beak Harap] and [Gaagshebla of Destruction] in “Avalon.” Then, complete the quest to [Frozen] in “Avalon.”

lines.text: (In a dead end alley in Avalon, a woman dressed as a battle lord is surrounded by what appears to be monsters.)
It was difficult driving it here. Ugh. I have confirmed that you are not the life of Eastland. then!
(As soon as the woman finished speaking, she took out the sword from the scabbard and swung it. Then, the beings from another world in front of her eyes disappeared with the spread of the sword.)
Phew… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Ren?
Wow, I was surprised! Since when have you been standing there?
Are you %s? I heard the story from my teacher. Please feel free to call me Ren instead of Ren. nice to meet you

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He was a monk and a disciple of the Sword God...an unusual background.)

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: You might already be surprised that I use a sword instead of a magic rod.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I kind of thought that way.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I was originally a monk at a temple, but for some reason I came to Eastland and met the teacher. And I became his disciple.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Weren't you attacked on your way to where I am? You seem a little tired... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a bit like that. It's okay though.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: No. It's not okay, so could you turn around for a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Ah, yes… . But why are you pointing the sword at me?!
(The sword Ren takes out of its scabbard passes by %s's back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Argh. It hurts… ? uh?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Doesn’t it hurt at all? In fact, I feel like I have become lighter.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Thank goodness. This is my sword.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: It's a slightly different style from Yuran, Ul, and L. My divine power only appears with the sword.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's amazing. also… .

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: If you feel like you're not feeling well here, come see me right away. I will cut you as much as I can with my sword.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… . I will take good care of my condition.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, then Ren… , What is the situation here now? Adkina said that a door has opened in Avalon.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Ah, I guess that's what Frozen said.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Frozen said he felt an ominous force inside and told me to wait here.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I think you went looking for that door... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Even now, the number of ominous beings in Avalon has increased.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: The door that Adkina mentioned probably connects another dimension to another place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It must have been made by Vice, right?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: As you know, Deimos is what Vice is trying to sing... . It looks almost ready, but something seems missing.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I don't know what that is. There's nothing he wants in Avalon. There are only unknown enemies who have come to ruin our world.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: There seem to be several places that appear to be doors. uh… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ren, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: An ominous energy that is not accurate to call evil is growing... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to go.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I'm going with you too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know where Frozen is, but I need to find him quickly.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I will escort you. The view ahead is blurry, so be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, please take care of me.

steps.name: door made of books
steps.objective: Defeat [Velosh] in “Vanitas.” Then, complete the quest to [Frozen] in “Avalon.”

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: You fool. Was this the only place you headed with your faith? Is this the answer you wanted?!

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: If that's your path... .
(As Frozen can hardly contain his excitement, the spirit on his shoulder begins to hover around him.)

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Sorry, Lou. Am I excited again? I'll be patient.
(Only then does the spirit named Luu return to Frozen's shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: 렌의 목소리
lines.text: Frozen! Frozen! Where are you?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Ren? wren!! I'm here!

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: %s is here too. Did anything go wrong on getting here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine, Frozen, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I'm glad nothing happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, over there… .

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: %s, can you sense an alien force over there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, a little… . Is there a door over there?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: There are two suspicious doors. One is a book, and the other is just a regular door. It seems like everyone is going to another world.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: I checked both doors, but found that I could only get in through the book door.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are regular doors blocked?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: It was half open, but I couldn't go in because of the energy from another world emanating from it.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: I think if I make it a little weaker, it will work somehow... .

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: What do you think? %s, do you want to try?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will do it.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Okay. If we work together, we can solve it. The method I propose is divine power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Divine power?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: There is divine power remaining on the other side of the door that appears to be a book. If you use the divine power there, you will be able to enter the half-open door.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Just a moment, Frozen. If it's divine power... .

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: The man who doubted God is there.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: … It's Velosh.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: When a person who follows God loses faith and becomes doubtful, his power deteriorates tremendously. Moreover, Velosh was so intoxicated by the power of ‘binding’ that even his spirit collapsed.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: My abilities didn't work on Velosh.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: As Velosh left the temple, he defeated the monks who tried to stop him. Only a few people, including Ren, were able to survive.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think you should meet that person.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Ren… .

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Yes, Frozen.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: You go back to the original spot where I told you to wait. From there, prevent enemies from getting near the cart wheel.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: The beings here cannot easily touch you. So trust me, trust you, trust everyone. Just like always.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Then, please just wait until everyone except Adkina comes out.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Yes, Frozen. I'll go right back to where I came from. %s, please take care of Frozen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry. wren.
(Ren nods in understanding and goes back the way he came. Ren leaves, and Frozen taps %s on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: %s, shall we go now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But superhumans are coming out?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: They have their own plans, so let's ask them later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Shall we go now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Belosh…, why didn’t he believe in Iris…. And why is he here….)
(Unlike the desolate Avalon, the place we entered following the light visible between the giant books is filled with warm light.)
(Under the falling light, many trees, a bookcase installed on the exterior wall, and many books on the bookshelf come into view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My eyes are so dazzling... .

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: There was a place like this. I only heard it in words... . %s, I don't think you should mess with it. be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. But do you know about this place?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: At the center of the denomination is the Bible, which is the doctrine itself. It shows different sides depending on the interpretation. Just like you can see many different things in the same place... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (…what if?)

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: There is an interpretation that only comes down to high-ranking officials in the church... .  I heard that beyond the great wall, there is a space where all the world's information is recorded.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: But, that information is expressed in a book like this... . I never even thought about it.
(Frozen’s gentle expression gradually hardens.)

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: It would be no wonder that Velosh came here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel like I'm in a sacred temple.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: %s, we have no gods here, so be careful.  It feels as if someone intentionally sprinkled divine energy here.

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: Correct answer!

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: DAMAGE, %s!!
(Frozen comes forward and counters a hook attack that comes from nowhere. Not just one, but several attacks come, but all attacks are useless in front of him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hope!!

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: That idiot hit all of these attacks, but Demigod sees through them all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Frozen, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: I'm fine. By the way, I guess you've already met Baral.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: About Phobos... .

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: It seems like not long ago, but it feels like a year has passed. I said I'd meet you in Avalon, but I didn't know we'd meet like this. Nice to meet you. idiot.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Baral, what on earth are you doing here?

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: I was just looking for something according to the contract. I was a bit surprised when you suddenly came in. No, was it natural?

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Weiss said it was a space where only those who received divine protection could enter. And they said it was disguised as sacred.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Vanitas… Did you say that? Well, Weiss said it was nice to rest here... .

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: The name is not important. Let's say Weiss came here because she is a being with superhuman strength, but how did you come in?

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: The noble Demigod asks, so I will answer.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: It seems the Spirit King's medicine was effective. After drinking what Elysion's younger brother had, he was able to go to the demon world and other worlds.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If it’s Elysion, it’s L’s brother’s name…. And that medicine….)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: I also got this from Vice. I have a lot to accept from other employers... . I don't have time to fool around, so I'll just leave.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: By the way, is what you guys are looking for the same as me? Then let’s see who finds it first!!

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Before the unholy Demigod guy's mind collapses!!
(After finishing speaking, Baral turns his back and disappears without a trace.)

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: %s, listen carefully. We have to finish Velosh. We need that strength. We must take back what belongs to God.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: If Baral takes it, it will be used in strange places... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to go quickly.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: This road looks complicated. Since Baral seems to have gone in the middle, we have no choice but to split up.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Any way, if Velosh is found or something happens, Luu will let you know right away. Luu is also affected by your energy now.
(Frozen lifts the spirit on her shoulder and shows it to her. Then the spirit Lu makes eye contact and smiles as if greeting her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Spirit, please take care of me.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: %s, please look over there. I'll go this way. Luu, then let’s go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Frozen.
(Frozen leaves first with Spirit Luu.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have something I want to ask Velosh, so let’s find out quickly… .
(The path between the trees and bookshelves built in the white space continues endlessly. And somewhere along the path, a suspicious purple light flows out.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this light? It feels like someone sprayed it on purpose... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is a mixture of ominous and sacred... .
(A powerful and ominous energy explodes in an instant, and the huge bookcases on the wall begin to crumble.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what is it?
(From there, a man wearing purple armor slowly walks out. Baral chases behind him and throws a chain at him, but he lightly bounces it away with his arm.)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Damn it!! Throw it out again? why? why! Has it never worked? It works well with that idiot and others too!!
Such a trivial attack won't even scratch me... .

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Velosh, hurry up! I'll deal with you properly!!

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: To have to hear my name through the mouth of an insignificant being like you... .
(When a person called Velosh lifts the broken magic rod, a huge explosion occurs around him.)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: He is a man of words. The guy named Demigod barely... .
(The bookshelf around Baral collapses, revealing a suspicious black hole hidden behind it.)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Huh? uh? what?!

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Goodbye. Never set foot in this world again.
(No sooner has he finished speaking than the explosion caused by Velosh continues. Due to the impact, Baral is sucked into the black hole and disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s the black hole I saw in Rosengarten. It was said to be a gap in space and time…)

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Since when have you been there? Is this a saboteur sent by Vice?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Velosh? I am… .

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: You, you!! I feel the same way as that woman.

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Ceres was trying to elevate her to a god... . It’s unpleasant… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you talking about? You are a demigod who follows God. Iris is now following in Ceres’ footsteps… .

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Shut up!! What kind of god is that woman?! That weak woman?!

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Now that I think about it, are you the guy she kept talking about? Does it make sense to wait for someone you've never seen before?
(Velosh looks at %s's face with an annoyed expression.)

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Why? Why did she become a god? shit… . A human chosen by God becomes a god? An incompetent human being with no power whatsoever!

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: We are humans created by the same God, but we are girls from a slightly different clan, so why?!

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Does that make sense? Since ancient times, God must awaken with omnipotent power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Barvatos... No, it reminds me of what Barbatos said. He said that a god must have that much power and ignored Iris and Gaia.)

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Hahaha, hahahahaha. The existence of God is truly arbitrary. They showed favoritism towards people like you and gave them protection arbitrarily.

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Ceres, Gaia, and that woman... . The gods are all as they please. Wow!!
(As Velosh screams in anger, the ominous energy surrounding him shakes.)

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: If you are truly blessed by God, you will be able to defeat the great Velosh. If you want to prove yourself, kill me. Otherwise you will die.

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: However, it won't be easy to kill. I am… .

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: I am!! The apostle of God whom everyone looks up to!! It's Demigod Velosh!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need your strength. So... .

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: My divine power... ? Hahaha, hahahahaha. In the end, you came to kill me!! Did she make him do that?!

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: It won't work out the way she wants. Because you will bleed and die right here... .
(Velosh makes an unpleasant expression and gathers unclean energy into the broken magic rod.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't persuade you anymore. I can't help it... .

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: I will stain this place with your blood. Apostle of a fake god!!

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Ha, ha... . That's not normal.
(After a long battle, Velosh steps back and observes %s's condition.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, ha... . Velosh. I'll say it again, I'm not here to kill you. To meet Weiss, you have to go through another door, and you need divine power... . therefore… .

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: The battle isn't over yet, but there's a lot to talk about... .
(As Velosh knocks on the wall, Vanitas' outer wall cracks. As a result, the black hole where Baral fell a moment ago grows larger.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop it!! Otherwise, everyone will fall into that gap!

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: You must be afraid.

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Then I'll give you the answer to what you want to know.

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: The church did not allow me to have any other questions. They forcibly restrained me because I was intoxicated by the power of restraint and because my mind had collapsed.

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Damn it, the world I saved with my own power treats me like this? Was I conceited? How dare you criticize me? I was released from the fucking bondage, but I wasn't drunk!!

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: It's not my fault. That woman ruined this world by accepting her fate as a god!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop it. Stop it... .

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: What are you going to do if I don't stop? Hahahaha.

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: I realized the truth here. A truth that a contradictory being like God Adventurer does not need to know... .
(The moment Velosh picks up the broken magic rod and points it towards %s, he suddenly falls to the floor.)

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Off… Wow!! Ahhhhh!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The power of bondage…?)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: The Apostle of God told me not to do the same thing as that guy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Vice!!

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Damn it, Vice!!

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Struggling like that. Stupid demigod.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Did you think that if you realized the truth, you would be able to get out of here? . He must have believed that he could survive if he became the god of Vanitas.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth is that... .

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Anyway, this is a space that will disappear for purgatory... . When the line between life and death is reached, we will head to Azrael.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: This is Azrael’s own Vanitas… . There is no need for vanitas from other worlds. The truth of Azrael will come down here... .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: … Are you listening?!
(Vice shouts into the space-time gap that has opened inside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Weiss, who are you talking to? What the hell now… .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: You weakling who sent me here... .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: I give you the results of your failed design.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: From Van to Velosh... . If possible, it would have been better to deal with Lux as well... . There wasn't enough time... .
(A suspicious power flows out from a black hole in the outer wall of Vanitas. The power takes the form of a black arm and grabs Velosh, his arms, legs, and head.)

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: I realized the truth.

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Oh my... ominous… In energy… Don't get eaten... ah… . Wow... .
(The black arms flowing out from the black hole turn into great darkness and swallow everything in the foolish Demigod without a trace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s the same as when half of the class disappeared….)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: %s… . There is nothing for you to do here.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: The divine power that the foolish Demigod possessed was sent to the other Demigods who came with you. He's still wandering around here... .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: The reason I called Demigod was just to buy him some time... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never got a proper answer from Velosh!!
(Vice deflects an attack from an angry %s with a laughable expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: There is no point in wasting time in this crumbling vanitas... . Now Purgatory will open and His power will come down.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: No matter what choice you make, you won't get the results you want, so I hope you don't overdo it... .
(With Weiss' words, the exterior walls and floor of Vanitas begin to split. In the shaking space, each other's figures gradually disappear from view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Weiss, wait there. I must... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, Lou? Frozen? Frozen, are you okay? Are you over there? let's go… .
(After seeing %s disappear in the distance, Weiss speaks to someone who comes up behind him with an exhausted expression.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: I almost died thanks to you.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: No matter how today ends, I will save you as I promised. Thanks to you, I delivered my message to the weak.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Thank you so much. I'm free because I worked hard, right?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: You can now work for Daphne.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Hearing that witch's name from Weiss' mouth gave me goosebumps... .  But there is one thing I want to ask.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: There's a door at the end of Avalon, not here. What was that thing that was standing there, that looked like you?
(As the spirit Luu finds a path between the bookshelves, Vanitas's appearance slowly disappears and Avalon's appearance comes in.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're out. Thanks, Lou.
(There is still a huge book that appears to be the entrance to Vanitas, but it feels different than before entering.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I go back in? No, you can't go back in now. Frozen? Where are you?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: %s!! Lou!! I'm here!!
(Frozen is seen waving his hand. Luu looks at Frozen and flies away smiling brightly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Rather… Velosh is dead, right? No, is it gone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Frozen about what happened when you met Velosh.)

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: I see… .

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: %s, I want to tell you something, can I?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please speak.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: My goal was to take Iris from the church's temple to Luman. After this was over, I tried to go back to Freios... .

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: As the work of the Deimos Church grew, I kept an eye on Avalon, and while trying to infiltrate, I learned many things. Meanwhile, a new mission was delivered from the church.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Condemn him with my own hand... . Velosh's arrogance and suspicion of God continued, but I thought it would end at some point... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Right... Okay.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: You don't have to feel sorry. Should I consider it a blessing among misfortunes that I didn’t finish it with my own hands? . Phew… .

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Anyway, Velosh's uncontaminated divine power came to me. Since it is not my power, I have no intention of making it completely my own and using it.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: … So, I'm thinking of using my strength to open that door where Vice is waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, but what was the truth that Velosh saw?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: That would be out of this world... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But may I ask what you learned from Avalon?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Of course. But is it okay if I listen to it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Then… .
(When Frozen stretches out his hand, the spirit Luu rises into the sky. After a while, it comes back down and flies around Frozen, scattering the energy of light.)

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Lou, okay. okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did Luu say?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: It is said that the superhumans came out of the wheel and dispersed, and Io and Ren are now together.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Shall we go there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Let's go.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: While I'm gone for a bit, let's get some treatment from Ren.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not serious, so there's no need to get treatment... . Ah, Frozen! Let's go together!

steps.name: Superman's resolution
steps.objective: Listen to [Io]'s story in 「The Other Side of Avalon」, and complete the quest to [Frozen] in 「Avalon」.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Thanks to Io and other superhumans, I was able to easily kill many enemies. thank you

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: No. Of course you have to... .
(Io looks at the fallen demons and beings from other worlds before her and suddenly becomes speechless.)

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Io, why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: No, that's... . I don't know. I feel like something that forms the axis of Avalon has disappeared... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Wait, shall we take a break? I don't have time to rest... .

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Io, are you okay? You'll be fine with my sword.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Uncle Baldrick is still in good spirits after being cut ten times and went hunting down demons, so he's definitely fine... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I feel a little weird about that. Uh, over there… .

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Frozen, %s!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ren! Hey! are you okay?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Thank goodness. Nothing seems to be happening. Io, Ren.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Io helped me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank goodness. But where are the others?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: They came out of the wheel and scattered. Frozen, do you have something to say?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Yes, this is what I and Io know, and what the Goddess Adventurer wants to know.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Yeah? then… . Ren, let’s talk for a moment in a quiet place. Please wait here.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Where are you going? Inside the cart?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The other side of Avalon.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: It's a place I can't go to. Then I'll wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Io, how do I get to the other side of Avalon? Maybe a snowball... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: How did you know?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Ah, it looks like Io did something with Deborah Seolwon’s eyes.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s, just come out and follow Frozen. Then you will see a new Avalon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: New Avalon... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's not the perfect Avalon that everyone called a utopia a long time ago, but at least there won't be the beings from other worlds that we see now... .
(After just taking a few steps forward following Frozen and Io, %s's field of vision shows a different-looking Avalon, just as Io said a moment ago.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, here… .
(Abalon, shrouded in sand and fog, is full of desolation and loneliness, just like the place where Weiss was.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: This is the other side of Avalon. It's the perfect place to come in and talk for a bit. By the way, %s, I've seen you here before.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, that's... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Io and Frozen about what you briefly saw in Kali Village before coming here.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Even if the witch wasn't playing around, it was a place she would come anyway. Anyway, this place… . First, I'll have to talk to %s.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You must have heard it from Jiscard. They all returned to the power of restraint. To be exact, it has become a magic stone.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You can think of this place now as a huge magic stone. To be precise, the power created by the magic stone has been amplified and is calling to a world where there are twisted people.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That all turned into magic stones?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Magic stones created by the power of lives that have died for hundreds of years are formed in clumps and are erected throughout Avalon.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: When we inspected the traces that had flowed into the Deborah Snowfield, we found that they belonged to the Deimos Church. Imitating life and humans... An organism made from magic stones.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The military and fanatics of the Dark Holy Kingdom of Deimos were originally people.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: They were believers who believed in Vice and followed a god called Deimos, but over time, they were replaced by something else.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: As you probably know, it is a magic stone. A magic stone created by Ban and Mara with the power they obtained from Weiss. Made with the power of life... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You must have seen them too... They imitated the Kali people in Adrica, and they hunted in the snowfields of Deborah, looking like our ancestors... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: They are all organisms made of magic stones. All the lives brought by the organisms became magic stones, and even those organisms returned to the form of magic stones.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I think it was sprinkled across Avalon and became the food that summoned Deimos. That's what it takes to summon Deimos... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: So we shared the power that Shinick had sealed in the wheel a long time ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it dangerous?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s Looking at your face, I can't lie.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: We're okay. Because I was prepared.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Frozen… . Stop everyone... .

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: You probably have your own definition... . If I were to stop you here now, would you be able to stop?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s, don't you know us? Don't worry too much. Because with that power, he is destroying all the magic stones throughout Avalon. Now with that effect… , uh?
(As soon as Io finishes speaking, the landscape of Avalon shakes as if distorted. Then, someone's voice is heard calling Io.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭의 목소리
lines.text: Hey, where are you? Come out!!

lines.speaker: 샤이닉의 목소리
lines.text: Hey!! Since the boring work is over, come through that door!!

lines.speaker: 메디아의 목소리
lines.text: Io, you can come now.

lines.speaker: 지스카드의 목소리
lines.text: Hey, come that way. %s too!!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Well done everyone. Then everyone comes there except Adkina.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: When Frozen goes back, take down Ren and the beings from other worlds that are chasing us.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: To open that door, you will need divine power.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Leave this to us. It would be better to save that sacred power for the church and Iris.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s, save your strength for Iris. Please. We trust you... .
(Io approaches %s and gently hugs her. A warmth that you wouldn't expect from someone who handles ice and snow.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Now, let's go out. If you do it one by one, you run.

steps.name: key to open the door
steps.objective: Defeat [Sinner Weiss] in “Purgatory Azrael.” Then, complete the quest to [Frozen] in “Avalon.”

lines.text: (As I run forward following Io, a sandstorm with a different texture blows. I return to Avalon, where beings from other worlds are hovering, but Ren is nowhere to be seen.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I escaped somewhere else. As expected, I'm not used to this... .

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Still, it's a relatively safe place near where Vanitas was.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Frozen, then ask Ren and the direction of the cart wheel. Uncle Baldrick took care of the rest, so you have to protect the wheel.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Then I will go straight to where Ren is.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Frozen, be careful.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Watch out for %s too. Good luck, Io.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you.
(As Frozen hurries towards Ren's direction, Io lightly taps %s on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Everyone is waiting inside. Let’s go on time too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I need to see for myself what that space that Weiss calls purgatory is like... .
(As you enter the suspicious door with ominous energy flowing out, the view you see catches everyone's attention.)
(Dazzling light flows over the ruins, which do not appear to be alive. When you look up and look at the sky, a white staircase leading somewhere between the clouds stretches out.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is purgatory… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Somewhere in this space, there must be a place that leads to that staircase leading to the sky. I'm sure there's a vice there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Uh, Io. excuse me… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Why is there something there?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Vice… .
(When Io makes eye contact with an unfamiliar person, she smiles coldly. After a while, the cold air flowing around Io stops and turns into a thin, sharp icicle.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Nice to meet you. You can solve it here.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: What are you talking about... . What on earth is that? .
(The icicle circling around Io heads toward Vice's chest. However, the icicle soon passes by him and crashes into the wall of a building standing far away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ugh, my ears, my ears hurt... Just like when Adkina said...)
(Every time a word comes out of Weiss's mouth, the energy flowing out approaches %s's ears, causing sharp pain like an awl.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Don't speak in God's language, speak in human language!! Deimos!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: To... , Deimos?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's definitely not a vise. However, the power of binding...)
(A Weiss-looking being called Deimos nods lightly.)

lines.speaker: 데이모스?
lines.text: I'm sorry. Children who follow Ceres.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It certainly looks like Vice, but it's not Vice. If it's Deimos...is it really a god who came down?)

lines.speaker: 데이모스?
lines.text: You are having doubts, but it is okay. The uneasy feeling you feel is the effect of the magic stone I am trapped in.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: I am the twisted one you all know. To be exact, a part of Deimos... . I know that it wasn't you who woke me up from my sleep.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: It must be the one you called Weiss.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: When the gods and twisted people of this world were destroyed by the chaos called Beast, the brothers Deimos and Phobos left this place like everyone else.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: Although they had once loved this place, they too had no choice but to leave in the face of extreme fear and helplessness.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: Some were like Ceres, while others fell to other worlds.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: And they promised never to come back here again. I had no intention of coming back.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: For a brief moment, there was a call to life that we loved. So Phobos sent his fragment to check.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: Pyeonlin never came back. I was swept away by the magic stone's energy and became someone's servant.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: Deimos also had a calling from the life he loved, so he sent me, his friend, to confirm it.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: I didn't expect that I, a member of Deimos, would be caught like this. To be caught like this by a magic stone disguised as a vise... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You, a twisted one, are you limited to that level of power?

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: I am just a part of the body… . The life force that Weiss called to me surpassed me.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: Now, this magic stone will transfer my power to him. And it will bring back fragments of Deimos from another time and space.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: The number of pieces that Deimos has is greater than the number of spirits that exist in this world.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: If the faction breaks through the great wall and reaches this place, no matter how much Deimos does not want to come here, it will respond to the life force that Weiss has gathered.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A situation where a god-level being has no choice but to do something he doesn't want to do... .

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: You know it too. The god-level beings who loved this place are not much different from you... .

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: I will sever the link between me and Deimos so that the other factions can arrive as late as possible... .

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: … And as always, you are worthy of the gods... .
(Deimos's side gradually hardens and does not say anything. Only a lump of magic stone that resembles Weiss remains.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Just as Deimos said... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I can feel the power of the twisted one flowing inside me. It must have gone to Weiss. Is Pyeonlin also like a soul? It feels like I'm in a magic stone and being transported... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That would have been the case with the devil named Beled. I heard from Peta that an organization called the Magic Agency of the Sylvaria Empire worked on transferring the souls of magic golems.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait a minute, I also met a small Degos in a cave near the mercenary camp...)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: There's no need to think deeply now. Other superhumans have already gone looking for Weiss. We have to go too. Hurry up!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Okay, let’s solve the problem at hand now. Think about it later…)
(The beings from other worlds defeated by Adventurer turn into purple flames and flow into purgatory.)

lines.text: I have no idea what you're talking about... . Why do I… .

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
