lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yeah, it's okay. Look carefully. When I stretch, every bone makes a sound, but it's okay.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: An ordinary person would have been sucked into a gap in space and time... . What on earth are you looking for?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Secret♡

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: It's not dangerous, right?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yeah, no.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Shinik, since you’re not feeling well right now, I’ll give you a cut. Since you are Shinik, I think it will take about 100 times... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I hate it because I feel like I'm going to die... .
(Medea notices something when Shinic, who would normally talk as a joke, speaks in a different tone. Then, she carefully approaches and quietly holds both hands.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The power of Perse that you have shared with everyone here is the power you have to overcome death... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shinik, you really risked your life this time... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Shinik, you said you had something to give us and you kept us there... . I guessed it. But that… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I didn't want to live alone. Anyway, that power will help everyone here... . Rather than me... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I said I was going to die, I almost died... Don't say things like that.
(Medea turns her back and hugs Shinik, who cannot continue speaking.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Don’t do that… .
(Io sees the two people and runs over to hug them.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: If the teacher saw this, he would definitely be happy. That's a shame. I heard that a foolish guy joined forces with several people... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: You will be watching from heaven. I also feel like the work I have done so far has come to an end.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Master… .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Thank you all for your hard work... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's really over... . A lot has happened since I met you all at Eastland.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: What, you talk like that as if you're someone you'll never see again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, no. I think I will receive a lot of help from you in the future. It seems like there's still a lot left to do... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Just say it. I will run and run wild wherever you call me. Instead, sparring is essential.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Good job, %s.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'm hungry... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Adkina?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Oh my!! Adkina is hungry!! Then, let’s all go to our village together. We've prepared a lot of food, so let's all go together.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I was hungry too, so it was a good thing. Meat, meat!!

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I really feel like all the hard work I've done so far is over, Frozen.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Ah, everyone. As previously discussed, Avalon will be managed by the Union of Light and the Ceres Church branch.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Just because the space-time gap disappears doesn't mean the work is over. We have to somehow purify it again and make it a land where life lives.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Adkina will perform some of the purification work in the form of a dragon.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Since Gaia has given permission, I plan to visit my hometown for a while and then stay here. I don't know how long it will take, but I have to make it like Adrika.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Now that I think about it, Gaia hasn’t been seen much these days….)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Frozen, since the wheel no longer has the power of death, I'll leave it to you here as well. I'm not leaving it to you because it's a hassle♡

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Thank you. I was wondering if I should open a new passage in the church, but it saved me the trouble.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Master.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Ren, why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I will turn a blind eye to your drinking medicinal liquor just this time. I won't tell Yuran.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Hahaha, thank you. Then you should go too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s really over. Really….)
(Io quietly approaches and pulls %s's hand and hugs him. Then he quietly pats his shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Don't worry too much. You will do well in the future. You did it all because you were with good people. Isn't it?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Don't forget that we were among such good people.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Everyone will now gradually free themselves from memories related to bondage. I will live dreaming of another future. Thank you for creating such a future.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Now I will live the rest of my life for everyone, for Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Io… . Everyone… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Now I see %s, the expressions are different. I can make all kinds of impressed expressions like that.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I looked like a fool at first♡

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hahahaha, what if you're an idiot? Let’s all go eat meat!! Meat genius!!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Now, let’s go to the folk tale of our village!

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Gerda… . It's a really beautiful place.
(Io looks proud as Medea looks around Gerda's various places.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Right? yes?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Everyone, I've talked to Gallet, so all you have to do is go in and wait a bit.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Haha, as expected, this place has the best meat!

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: … It smells delicious. When I see that I want to eat food, I feel like I put in a lot of effort.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work. Adkina.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: What kind of trouble did I have... . Didn't you all do it?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Ren, thank you for your hard work. For now, take a break and find something to do in Eastland.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Yes, I will. I was already planning on staying in Gerda a little longer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Everyone looks happy. I guess it's because Eastland's work is over...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Why do I feel so empty….)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Uh, goddess? Oh, nice to meet you! Let’s go eat meat together!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris?
(When I look back, Iris is in front of the group, including Superman, with an embarrassed expression on his face.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hello everyone.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Iris, long time no see.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Iris!!

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Goddess, is that fun? Then take me too♡

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shinik, please be polite to the goddess.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Don’t be so mean, Medea. I also paid some attention to it.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm fine. Medea, Shinik.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Iris, what's going on?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry. I think I need to take Adventurer with me now.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Iris… . No, Iris. You have some business to attend to %s. Hey guys, get ready.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Goddess… .  This is my first time meeting you, and I would be so sorry if you leave like this.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: (Iris is here….)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I will come back to Gerda next time. So don't be too disappointed.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Yes, please come back again.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s, close your eyes and take my hand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah.
(The moment Iris and %s's hands touch, a mysterious light surrounds them and takes them somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Then I will eat your share of the meat.
(As the superhumans who saw the two people off enter the story, Shinik gently grabs Medea, who was the last to enter.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea, over there… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I have something to give you... .
(Shaynik takes something out of his pocket and puts it in Medea’s hand.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This is... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: These are tears of welcome found in purgatory. I think I should give it to Medea. It looks like Vice made it under a contract with the Rabbit Witch... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Open your eyes, %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's good that the Eastland thing is over... . I feel like something is missing... . I'm sorry, I didn't mean to look like this... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's okay. I am… .
(Iris approaches carefully and hugs you gently.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s warm….)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s I understand you. Just like you understood me... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: When everyone's strengths are gathered together based on faith to solve a big problem... . And I still haven't forgotten that feeling when other things come my way. No, I can't forget.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm not sure what to do next... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: But, as time passed, things got a little better.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s will be fine over time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is everything okay? It'll be okay, right?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Let’s find it together. I'll be with you until you feel better.  Just like you did for me... .
(Iris smiles brightly and holds both hands.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Iris… . Thanks to you, it got better.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But if you called me here, you have something to talk about, right?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I think I probably know the clues to the feeling %s felt... . I'm just trying to tell you that.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Gaia… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Gaia disappeared with the words that she would go somewhere for a while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where did you go... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm not sure... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I keep looking for where Gaia is, but what I am certain about is that she is not in this world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Don't worry too much. As I continue to follow the great wall... . Gaia will also send you a message.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, okay. I'll take a break and then come back to see what I can do for Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's something I'd like to ask Gaia, too.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes, I also want to meet Gaia again. Now I will send you to Gerda.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: See you later. %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Iris… . Well then, goodbye.
